name: ODSH-Native
description: Bring DeepSeek Harness (DSH) execution + plugin/capability surface natively into OpenClaw: A-class agent tools (exec/cua/visual/file + DSH-style plugins) and B-class resident services (auto-watch/scheduler + hosting select DSH Harness plugins).

configSchema.description: No config keys are wired yet: all runtime knobs (CUA_REMOTE, DSH_WORKER_ENDPOINT, plugins dir, ...) are read from the environment. Formerly declared keys (pluginsDir/watch/dshWorker) were removed because nothing consumed them - see CHANGELOG.
